title.zh: 机械臂运动学 · 从关节角到末端
title.en: Robot-arm kinematics · from joint angles to the hand

description.zh: 二连杆机械臂的末端位置是两段连杆向量之和：给定两个关节角就能算出手在哪（正运动学）；反过来给定目标点求关节角（逆运动学）通常有“肘上、肘下”两组解；两杆伸直共线时，某些方向怎么转关节都动不了，叫奇异位形。
description.en: The tip of a two-link arm is the sum of two link vectors: given the two joint angles you can compute where the hand is (forward kinematics); going back from a target point to joint angles (inverse kinematics) usually has two answers, elbow-up and elbow-down; when the links line up straight, some directions cannot be reached by any joint motion — a singular configuration.

label.zh: 末端 = 两段向量相加
label.en: Hand position = sum of two vectors

reason.zh: 每段连杆是一个长度为 lᵢ、方向由关节角决定的向量，末端位置就是把两段首尾相接相加。
reason.en: Each link is a vector of length lᵢ pointing in a direction set by the joint angles, and the hand position is the two vectors added head to tail.

label.en: cos and sin split out the coordinates

reason.zh: 连杆向量的横、纵分量是 l·cosθ 和 l·sinθ；第二段的方向是 θ₁ + θ₂，所以 x、y 公式里出现两个角之和。
reason.en: A link vector’s horizontal and vertical parts are l·cosθ and l·sinθ; the second link points along θ₁ + θ₂, which is why the x and y formulas contain the sum of the two angles.

reason.zh: Jacobian 把关节速度映射成末端速度，二连杆的 det J = l₁l₂ sinθ₂；两杆共线时 sinθ₂ = 0，矩阵把速度平面压扁成一条线，有一个方向再也动不了。
reason.en: The Jacobian maps joint speeds to hand velocity, and for two links det J = l₁l₂ sinθ₂; when the links line up sinθ₂ = 0, the matrix squashes the velocity plane onto a line, and one direction of motion is lost.
